steps.note: Start a single-stage event creation flow for the auction.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction template.
Add a line item so the auction has a lot to bid on.
Invite the QA vendor needed to inspect the supplier view.
Publish the auction so it is live and available to the vendor.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the live auction's vendor bidding screen.

args.text: You are bidding on the total lot amount we received from your RFQ Quotes. A request for line item-wise cost breakdown will be triggered once the auction submission time ends.
